newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP 11-mth coal, iron ore output up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP 11-mth coal, iron ore output up.

text.p: The Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd said on Monday its that iron ore production from Western Australia mines rose six percent in the 11 months to April, while coal production from Queensland mines rose nine percent.
BHP attributed the higher iron ore production to more demand for production from its Yandi mines, especially Japanese demand.
BHP recently announced that expansion work had boosted the Yandi operation's total capacity to 35 million tonnes a year.
But higher output and shipments from Yandi was partially offet by lower production at Samarco in Brazil, BHP said.
"Lower production of iron ore at Samarco in Brazil was due mainly to downtime of the primary mill during integration with the expansion project," BHP said.
The rise in coal production partly reflected the start of full production at Mt Owen in October 1996, it added.
